decision_scope: Use pinned offline policy-learning and FQE interfaces as proposal challengers; defer enabled integration.
rationale: Modular learners, episode objects and FQE provide a useful independently evaluated challenger.
Episode boundaries, scorer population, deterministic-policy target and reward/clock semantics need explicit controls.
Observed source issues have concrete proposed repairs, so rejecting all research use is not justified.
No direct adoption is justified by package naming, README benchmarks or a finite loss alone.

alternatives.reason: Missing native semantic oracle, resolved environment and independent evaluation.
Preserves upstream maintenance while isolating data, target, scorer and failure contracts.
Recreating neural learners, preprocessing and checkpoint semantics adds equivalence and maintenance cost without a measured benefit.
Enables a concrete public/generated comparison now without product capability claims.
Scoped semantic defects can be constrained or repaired and tested.

alternatives.route: tabular dynamic programming and direct generated rollouts
alternatives.reason: Exact finite model values isolate conversion error before neural approximation.
Sequential policy evaluation and contextual-bandit targets cannot inherit this package approval.

owner_obligations.scientific: Own history sufficiency, sequential exchangeability, support, censoring and target population.
owner_obligations.integration: Own episode/clock/reward/policy conversions, scorer fixes and no-loss row reconciliation.
owner_obligations.runtime: Own environment locks, dependency notices, checkpoint formats and requalification after updates.
owner_obligations.evaluation: Own independent public/generated episodes, predeclared tuning and failed-fit/uncertainty accounting.

costs_to_measure: Episode reconstruction and bank target review
Training plus FQE across configurations and seeds
Failed runs, evaluation splits and clustered uncertainty
Scorer repair, compatibility and regression maintenance
revisit_trigger: A pinned public/generated prototype passes the explicit native and wrapper oracles, resolves package/dependency rights and reproduces target-preserving held-out evaluation.
